notes.title: List of updated contents from April to June
notes.content:
----What`s New----
1."Rolling fun" comes on stage!! (entrance: upper left of the Control room)
2.New character From Nisshoukou, Kennshu Hizame(excellent), comes on stage!
3.New tactical position Forge, comes on stage!
4.Card back image selection system is added to the order tab of the Info-Panel.
5.The second wave of rewards: 【Forger】x 2！

----What`s Changed----
1.Suimugetsu(standard)`s skill redo
2.Enhanced "Beat back": the target will be dizzied if it cannot be beated back.
3.Adjusted "Poisoned": effect when attacking/doing scheme damage/curing.
4.Enhanced card 【Snipe】.
5.Weaken card 【Chilly season】.
6.Adjusted the list of trust skill for all characters.
7.Added several new build buffs to Adventure Mode.

----What`s Optimized----
1.A better system for guidance and game introduction.
2.A better experience for using items in Story and Adventure.
3.Get a new powerful buff when start a chapter for the first time.
4.Optimized the awards list of chapter information panel.
5.You can understand a character is leader or not on your awards list.

----What`s fixed----
1.Yin Ling(complete) may be stuck when she into the battle field.
2.When target has been changed, the following target has not changed at the same time.
3.Showing position of Card Cost change effect is wrong.
4.NPC`s Leader can stealth all the time.
5.Trap 【Stealth Strategy】 will be triggered when a leader already stealth.

notes.title: A bug that automatic end round function may cause a crash has been fixed
notes.content:
The bug that the automatic end round function would cause a crash in the first stage of the chapter "Graduation training" under the fast and extreme animation settings has been fixed.
The game has only been online for a few hours, and bugs have occurred one after another. Wanzi is very sorry for this!
I promise that I will test carefully from now on, and put an end to this vicious bug before the update. I am very grateful to the commander for continuing to support me and "Panacle"!

notes.title: Emergency repair for bugs in recruitting and creating of Info Panel
notes.content: The bug has been fixed, it`s just a UI bug, will not affect the tokens that have been obtained. At present, both the ea version and the trial version have been repaired. After the update, the functions of the Info Panel can be used normally. I apologize for the inconvenience caused.

notes.title: The developer of 《Panacle: Back to the Wild》, will try the game on site
notes.content:
"Panacle" is too difficult to get started?
It`s OK, Wanzi will show you how to get started easily.
"Panacle" is not hardcore enough?
It`s OK, Wanzi will in-depth analysis of the installed content, and reveal the future design direction.
The story of "Panacle" is not exciting enough?
It` OK, Wanzi will show you the world view, and reveal the general direction of the future story.
Full of surprises, do not come to watch?
